root_cause.text: The `l2cap_information_rsp` function in the Bluetooth L2CAP subsystem fails to validate that the command length (`cmd_len`) of an incoming response packet is sufficient to cover the type-specific payload before reading from `rsp->data`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds bounds checks (`cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(u32)` and `cmd_len >= sizeof(*rsp) + sizeof(rsp->data[0])`) to prevent out-of-bounds reads when accessing `rsp->data` for the `L2CAP_IT_FEAT_MASK` and `L2CAP_IT_FIXED_CHAN` information types.
